android.versions: API-level/device-profile matrix; current and legacy releases where the required ABI and security interfaces exist

ios.versions: iOS/iPadOS release family and device-generation profiles
ios.status: hosted_supported; baremetal only where an authorized/research-compatible boot and hardware interface exists

other_mobile_os.strategy: hosted_or_ported_adapter where the platform permits it; baremetal requires hardware-specific boot and driver support

safety: A device is never marked baremetal_supported merely because its CPU architecture matches. Boot chain, drivers, security state and recovery must also be validated.
